findings.current: It’s one of the ones that fled the battle earlier.
findings.defect: The source says the newly appeared Ant Lion had larger pincers and stronger mana than any Ant Lion Jin knew. The assembled copy omits both details.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes the monster’s unusually large pincers and powerful mana before Jin identifies it as one of the earlier escapees.
findings.replacement: It’s one of the ones that fled the battle earlier. Its pincers were larger and its mana stronger than those of any Ant Lion I knew.

summary: One source-specific physical and power detail is missing from the assembled copy.
